title: Smiling Toddler, Stuffed Plaid Bunny Rabbit - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful black-and-white family snapshot captured in June 1956 featuring a smiling toddler learning to stand. Dressed in light-colored bib overalls, a long-sleeve shirt, and soft white walking shoes, the child leans against a polka-dot bedspread alongside a large stuffed bunny dressed in a plaid outfit. The photograph features deckled edges and an authentic 'JUN 56' photofinisher stamp on the right margin, quintessential to mid-century American domestic baby photography.
